name: Riley
source: Riley is just your average teenage girl. As an only child with a typical family, she's always been a "daddy's girl," but there's a bit of a mean and greedy side to her as well. During her childhood her parents took her to the zoo, and Riley is obsessed with skunk-themed gadget ever since then. Being a child, she thought they were a cute (and didn't know they stink).
